{{Top|leg}}
The '''Network Shipyard''' was an old, prefabricated construction dome located one [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] from the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[D'larah]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demophon]]. Originally used in the construction of the dome covering D'larah, it was co-opted by the [[G'uotr Network]] to house the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] they used, as well as the ones they had hijacked.
